quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Always' precedes the verb. 'Before assembling' shows preparation.
quests.explanation: Subject (She) + always (adverb) + reads (verb) + the instructions (object) + before assembling any furniture (time clause). 'Before + verb-ing' shows a preparatory step.
quests.textToSpeak: She always reads the instructions before assembling any furniture.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'Carefully' modifies the verb. 'Before starting' shows sequence.
quests.explanation: Subject (He) + carefully (adverb) + measured (verb) + the ingredients (object) + before starting to bake (time). Adverbs like 'carefully' can appear between subject and main verb.
quests.textToSpeak: He carefully measured the ingredients before starting to bake.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. Two gerund phrases: checking before planning.
quests.explanation: Subject (They) + checked (verb) + the weather forecast (object) + before planning the outdoor event (time). Checking the forecast first shows responsible, logical preparation.
quests.textToSpeak: They checked the weather forecast before planning the outdoor event.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. Two manner adverbs joined by 'and'. Recipient ends the sentence.
quests.explanation: Subject (She) + explained (verb) + the situation (object) + calmly and clearly (manner) + to her boss (recipient). Two manner adverbs can be joined by 'and' to show both qualities.
quests.textToSpeak: She explained the situation calmly and clearly to her boss.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. Two actions joined by 'and'. 'Early' ends the sentence.
quests.explanation: Subject (He) + finished (verb 1) + all his tasks (object 1) + and + left (verb 2) + the office (object 2) + early (time). The two actions imply the first enabled the second.
quests.textToSpeak: He finished all his tasks and left the office early.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'To make them easier' expresses the purpose.
quests.explanation: Subject (They) + reorganized (verb) + the files (object) + to make them easier to find (purpose). 'To make something easier to do' is a common purpose clause structure.
quests.textToSpeak: They reorganized the files to make them easier to find.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'Detailed' describes the email. 'To the whole team' is the recipient.
quests.explanation: Subject (She) + sent (verb) + a detailed email (object) + to the whole team (recipient). 'Detailed' means thorough and comprehensive.
quests.textToSpeak: She sent a detailed email to the whole team.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'To attend the funeral' gives the purpose.
quests.explanation: Subject (He) + requested (verb) + a day off (object) + to attend the funeral (purpose). 'Request a day off' is more formal than 'ask for a day off'.
quests.textToSpeak: He requested a day off to attend the funeral.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'With the client' is the participant. 'On Friday' is the time.
quests.explanation: Subject (They) + arranged (verb) + a conference call (object) + with the client (participant) + on Friday (time). 'Conference call' means a phone or video meeting with multiple participants.
quests.textToSpeak: They arranged a conference call with the client on Friday.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'Enough money' reaches the goal. 'To buy' is the purpose.
quests.explanation: Subject (She) + saved (verb) + enough money (object) + to buy a new laptop (purpose). 'Enough + noun + to + verb' shows you have the minimum needed to do something.
quests.textToSpeak: She saved enough money to buy a new laptop.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'Online' is the method. 'Before making' shows preparation.
quests.explanation: Subject (He) + compared (verb) + prices (object) + online (place) + before making his final decision (time). 'Before + verb-ing' shows the step taken prior to a conclusion.
quests.textToSpeak: He compared prices online before making his final decision.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'Between savings and expenses' divides into two categories.
quests.explanation: Subject (They) + split (verb) + their monthly budget (object) + between savings and expenses (division). 'Split between A and B' means dividing something into exactly two parts.
quests.textToSpeak: They split their monthly budget between savings and expenses.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'During' introduces the time period.
quests.explanation: Subject (She) + visited (verb) + her family (object) + during the long holiday weekend (time). 'During' is used to say when something happened within a specific time period.
quests.textToSpeak: She visited her family during the long holiday weekend.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'Along the coastal highway' describes the route.
quests.explanation: Subject (He) + planned (verb) + a road trip (object) + along the coastal highway (route). 'Along' shows movement following a path: along the coast, along the river.
quests.textToSpeak: He planned a road trip along the coastal highway.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'In the mountains' is location. 'For a week' is duration.
quests.explanation: Subject (They) + rented (verb) + a cabin (object) + in the mountains (location) + for a week (duration). 'For + time period' expresses duration.
quests.textToSpeak: They rented a cabin in the mountains for a week.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'To improve' gives the purpose for joining.
quests.explanation: Subject (She) + joined (verb) + a yoga class (object) + to improve her flexibility (purpose). 'Join a class' means to become a member; 'to improve' introduces the reason.
quests.textToSpeak: She joined a yoga class to improve her flexibility.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. Two purpose ideas: cycling to work, and reducing emissions.
quests.explanation: Subject (He) + started (verb) + cycling to work (gerund phrase) + to reduce his carbon footprint (purpose). 'Carbon footprint' is the amount of greenhouse gas emissions caused by a person's activities.
quests.textToSpeak: He started cycling to work to reduce his carbon footprint.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'Cut out' is a phrasal verb meaning to eliminate.
quests.explanation: Subject (They) + decided (verb) + to cut out processed food (infinitive phrase) + from their diet (scope). 'Cut out' means to stop consuming or using something completely.
quests.textToSpeak: They decided to cut out processed food from their diet.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. Two actions: entering and winning.
quests.explanation: Subject (She) + entered (verb 1) + the art competition (object 1) + and + won (verb 2) + second prize (object 2). The second action is the positive outcome of the first.
quests.textToSpeak: She entered the art competition and won second prize.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'Annual' means once a year.
quests.explanation: Subject (He) + performed (verb) + at the annual school talent show (place/event). 'Annual' means happening once per year; 'talent show' is a performance event.
quests.textToSpeak: He performed at the annual school talent show.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. Two actions at the same event.
quests.explanation: Subject (They) + attended (verb 1) + the gallery opening (object 1) + and + bought (verb 2) + a small painting (object 2). 'Gallery opening' is the launch event for a new art exhibition.
quests.textToSpeak: They attended the gallery opening and bought a small painting.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'To communicate' is the purpose. 'More easily' is comparative.
quests.explanation: Subject (She) + downloaded (verb) + a translation app (object) + to communicate abroad more easily (purpose). 'More easily' is the comparative form of the adverb 'easily'.
quests.textToSpeak: She downloaded a translation app to communicate abroad more easily.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'To convert' is purpose. 'Quickly' ends the sentence.
quests.explanation: Subject (He) + used (verb) + an online tool (object) + to convert the currency (purpose) + quickly (manner). 'Convert currency' means to change money from one currency to another.
quests.textToSpeak: He used an online tool to convert the currency quickly.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'Before flying' shows cultural preparation.
quests.explanation: Subject (They) + researched (verb) + the local customs (object) + before flying to Japan (time). Researching customs before travelling shows cultural awareness and respect.
quests.textToSpeak: They researched the local customs before flying to Japan.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'Herself' is reflexive - she learned independently.
quests.explanation: Subject (She) + taught herself (reflexive) + to code (infinitive) + using free online resources (means). 'Teach yourself' means to learn without a formal teacher, through self-study.
quests.textToSpeak: She taught herself to code using free online resources.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'For his photography portfolio' gives the purpose.
quests.explanation: Subject (He) + built (past tense) + a simple website (object) + for his photography portfolio (purpose). A 'portfolio' is a collection of someone's creative work to demonstrate skills.
quests.textToSpeak: He built a simple website for his photography portfolio.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'Across different time zones' shows the global challenge.
quests.explanation: Subject (They) + collaborated (verb) + on a digital project (topic) + across different time zones (scope). 'Across time zones' means people in different parts of the world worked together.
quests.textToSpeak: They collaborated on a digital project across different time zones.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'In a secure manager' is where she stored them.
quests.explanation: Subject (She) + organized (verb) + all her passwords (object) + in a secure manager (place). A 'password manager' is software that safely stores and organizes login credentials.
quests.textToSpeak: She organized all her passwords in a secure manager.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'Before updating' shows data was protected first.
quests.explanation: Subject (He) + backed up (phrasal verb) + all his files (object) + before updating the system (time). 'Back up' means to create a copy of data in case the original is lost.
quests.textToSpeak: He backed up all his files before updating the system.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'To protect' is purpose. 'From attacks' is the threat.
quests.explanation: Subject (They) + installed (verb) + security software (object) + to protect their network (purpose) + from attacks (threat). 'Protect from' means to keep safe from a specific danger.
quests.textToSpeak: They installed security software to protect their network from attacks.
